Gujarat Ambuja Cement Ltd has informed the Exchange that at the meeting of BODs of the company held on January 20 2005 the company has pursuant to the approval of the BODs entered into various agreements with Holdcem Cements Private Limited and Holderind Investments Limited,both subsidiaries of Holcim Ltd. and forming part of the Holcim group, one of the world's leading cement manufacturers in relation to: a)The establishment of a business co-operation and financial collaborations between the Company and Holcim through Ambuja Cement India Limited(ACIL); b)Holcim acquiring 67% of ACIL through acquisition of existing shares held by investors as well as through primary subscription to new equity and preference shares.The overall investment to be made by Holcim for acquiring its stake in ACIL as aforesaid is approximately Rs. 3500 crores; c)The company will continue to hold 33% of ACIL pursuant to the dilution on account of the proposed infusion of capital through subscription to shares by Holcim; d)Holcim will make an open offer, and ACIL will, upon and subject to Holcim receiving FIPB approval,as a person acting in concert acquire shares of Associated Cement Companies Limited at a price of Rs.370 per share tendered pursuant to such offer with a view to acquire majority shareholding; e)Holcim will also make an open offer for shares of Ambuja Cement Eastern Limited at a price of Rs.70 in compliance with its obligations under the takeover code; f)The company will act in concert with Holcim in relation to its aforesaid open offers upon and subject to Holcim receiving FIPB approval; and  g)The company has also entered into shareholder arrangements with Holcim with a view to regulate their rights and obligations inter se as well as in relation to ACIL.
